title: Project Bank
description: Pre-verified project content. Every bullet here is hand-written and fact-checked against a source-of-truth record; the tool selects and formats these strings verbatim and never generates new ones. Point your editor at this schema for completion and inline validation while editing project_bank.json.

propertyNames.description: Stable project key: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

title.description: LaTeX-formatted title, used verbatim on the resume.

github.description: owner/repo, with no https:// prefix -- the template adds it. A bare owner produces a profile link and is reported by the bank linter.

domain.description: Lowercase domain tags. A domain hit is worth more than a keyword hit when scoring.

keywords.description: Lowercase terms matched against the job description with word-boundary anchoring.

bullets.description: Pre-written, LaTeX-formatted bullets. Used verbatim -- fact-check before adding.

hidden.description: Exclude from listing, matching AND generation. Use for unverified or incomplete projects that must never reach a resume.
